summary: Standing Lewis County, Tennessee Division of Forestry tower; 1952 photo and 2006 visit report; NHLR-registered January 2015; build date not found.

access.note: Active state forestry site with a house and maintenance sheds; the 2006 visit report found the site secure. No posted rules found. Level is inferred from that report, not stated by any source.

events.note: A 1952 photo, courtesy of the Tennessee Secretary of State, appears on the Register page; the caption does not say what it shows, so it only suggests the tower was standing by then
Visit report dated March 4, 2006 by Jerry Lutes: cab open, firefinder table and base still inside, not used for observation for some time, marked not staffed, site secure
Registered January 3, 2015 as US 1083, TN 22; nominated by Jerry Lutes

notes_for_editor: No build date found in any source read; the 1952 photo caption does not describe the image, so it only suggests the tower was standing by then. The only condition and staffing evidence is one visitor report from March 2006, so current condition and access are not established. The access level 'restricted' is my inference from the report's wording and should be changed if TDF says otherwise. The 60-foot figure comes from a visitor's note and may describe height; it was not converted to height_m. The 1952 photo has no image URL in the text read, so it is not in the photos list. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the name, county, agency and Register header. The Register page gives no climbing rules, so the story only advises checking with the Division of Forestry before going up.
